google_oauth.notes: Client ID + Secret set in Railway. Consent screen published. Google sign-in works for all users.

youtube_api.what: YouTube Data API v3 key active
youtube_api.notes: View verification returns autoVerified: true for YouTube URLs. TikTok oEmbed + Instagram manual as fallbacks.

google_analytics.notes: 6 conversion events tracked via lib/analytics.ts. GA script injected in root layout.

stripe.what: Switch Stripe from test to live mode
stripe.why: Payments won't process real money in test mode

email.how: Sign up at resend.com (free: 100/day) or brevo.com (free: 300/day). Set in Railway: SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, SMTP_FROM.
email.why: Welcome emails, approval/rejection/payout notifications won't send without this
email.note: System gracefully logs emails to console when SMTP_PASS is missing — never crashes.

spotify.what: Add Spotify API credentials for artist follower counts
spotify.how: Create app at developer.spotify.com → Client ID + Secret. Railway: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID=..., SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET=...
spotify.why: Artist cards will show follower count as social proof
spotify.note: Uses client credentials (app-level auth). One credential set works for all artists — no per-artist auth needed.

cron_secret.why: YouTube view auto-update cron is unprotected without this

tiktok_oauth.what: TikTok OAuth credentials for social connect
tiktok_oauth.why: TikTok social connect shows 'not configured' without these

instagram_oauth.what: Instagram OAuth credentials for social connect
instagram_oauth.why: Instagram social connect shows 'not configured' without these
